currentParagraphText: “Did the Lumenflight reach out?” Scarlett asked.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Did the Lumenflight reach out?” Scarlett asked.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Yes, they showed interest in being part of a second wave if possible. For now, they have too many other areas to focus on and not enough members to confidently expand,” the demon answered.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “My Lady, the members of the Emberflight should be here shortly, but I was informed they were running a little late,” a succubus informed her as Scarlett sat deep in thought within her way-too-big training chamber.
